snapshot: WHO European Region. Cut its aid budget by 40% and says it will keep prioritising areas the United States has stopped funding. Yvette Cooper became Health Secretary in Prime Minister Andy Burnham's first reshuffle in July 2026.

leadership.role: Secretary of State for Health and Social Care
leadership.name: Yvette Cooper

agenda.title: Aid cuts and global health priorities
agenda.text: In March 2026, when she was Foreign Secretary, Yvette Cooper told Parliament's International Development Committee that the UK strongly disagrees with the US approach to health aid. The UK has cut its aid budget by 40% and will keep funding water and sanitation, support for women and girls and sexual health. Its three-year GBP 850 million Global Fund pledge has two-thirds arriving in year three, and HIV funding will not be fully protected.

agenda.title: New Health Secretary and the NHS
agenda.text: Cooper was appointed Health Secretary in July 2026. Early pressure points named by the sector include nursing pay reform and the state of NHS performance.

agenda.title: Ebola precautions
agenda.text: A UK resident was evacuated after potential exposure to the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo (ECDC, 6 November 2026).
